source_text: Treat every input as untrusted at the trust boundary; validate and escape at the edge, not deep in the call stack.
pattern: Treat every input as untrusted at the trust boundary; validate and escape at the edge, not deep in the call stack.
reason: Validation at the edge stops injection at the source.

source_text: Grant the minimum privilege necessary; a background job that holds admin credentials turns one bug into a full breach.
pattern: Grant the minimum privilege necessary; a background job that holds admin credentials turns one bug into a full breach.
reason: Privilege is the blast radius of a bug.

source_text: Never commit secrets; use environment variables and a secret store, and rotate anything that was ever exposed.
pattern: Never commit secrets; use environment variables and a secret store, and rotate anything that was ever exposed.
reason: A committed secret is a public secret.

source_text: Dependency CVEs are real risk: audit dependencies on a schedule and patch known vulnerabilities before adding new features.
pattern: Dependency CVEs are real risk: audit dependencies on a schedule and patch known vulnerabilities before adding new features.
reason: Your supply chain is part of your attack surface.

source_text: STRIDE-style threat modeling catches the architectural assumptions OWASP checklists miss; run both.
pattern: STRIDE-style threat modeling catches the architectural assumptions OWASP checklists miss; run both.
reason: Checklists find known bugs; threat models find design holes.
